cost_model: sum(abs(delta_weight)) * slippage_bps, charged on the execution session -- the frozen scripts/screen_lane.py / scripts/run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.py convention, unchanged from batch-2.
replacement_rule_cost_note: The owner's replacement rule condition (c) re-checks the select-window Sharpe at 20bp specifically so a variant cannot qualify on a 10bp-only cost edge that evaporates once cost doubles.
e5_e6_extra_signal_dates_note: E5/E6 add exit-only signal dates inside the holding month (10th session, or the 4th Friday); each such exit is itself a full delta-weight rebalance (risk-on position -> 100% SHY) and is charged the same per-side slippage as any other rebalance -- no cost discount for the extra turnover these two variants introduce.
